blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Our in-house team of scientists and di…
blocks_element.text: Our in-house team of scientists and dietitians designs our formulas for safety and efficacy, and we’re ready to prove it. We’ve committed $5 million to complete clinical trials on all of our products by 2030.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Discover Our Clinical Studies Program
Paragraphe · We invested in a clinical trial with A…
blocks_element.text: We invested in a clinical trial with Auburn University to quantify the impact of Essential for Women 18+. Our findings include an increase in Vitamin D3 levels by 43%, significantly greater than placebo.¹* The study results are published in Frontiers in Nutrition.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · 1-Based on a 12 week double‐blind, ran…
blocks_element.text: 1-Based on a 12 week double‐blind, randomized, placebo‐controlled clinical study that was carried out on 94 women ages 21 to 40 years old

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · In partnership with Brooklyn College C…
blocks_element.text: In partnership with Brooklyn College CUNY, scientists completed a clinical trial during pregnancy to quantify the impact of Essential Prenatal—making it the only leading prenatal multivitamin backed by its own human clinical trial. One insight was that Moms taking Essential Prenatal maintained adequate folate levels throughout pregnancy. It also resulted in less unmetabolized folic acid in mom’s blood and the placenta compared to those taking a leading prenatal with folic acid, indicating more efficient folate utilization.²* The study results are published in Frontiers in Nutrition.
2-Based on a 24-week, randomized, double-blind, controlled clinical trial on 62 second and third trimester pregnant women

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · In partnership with Brooklyn College C…
blocks_element.text: In partnership with Brooklyn College CUNY, scientists completed a clinical study over 10 weeks to quantify the impact of Essential Postnatal, which is now clinically proven to improve breast milk quality and support mom’s nutrient demands. Maternal blood and breast milk samples showed that Moms taking Essential Postnatal had increased levels of three key components of breast milk compared to the placebo, including Biotin, Omega-3 DHA, and 3-FL (a prebiotic HMO that supports early gut microbiome development). Mom’s taking Essential Postnatal also had more Biotin and more total Folate in their blood than the placebo.³*
3-Based on a 10-week, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial on 64 breastfeeding women

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · We quantified the impact of our HyaCer…
blocks_element.text: We quantified the impact of our HyaCera™ on skin smoothness in partnership with Princeton Consumer Research (PCR). A key finding includes a 356% reduction in crow’s feet wrinkles at 12 weeks, compared to placebo.⁴* The results are published in Dermatology and Therapy.
4-Based on a 12-week randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical study on 63 women and men ages 26 to 64 years old

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · We partnered with Exeter University to…
blocks_element.text: We partnered with Exeter University to study the impact of our Sleep BioSeries™ Melatonin. We found (along with other results) Sleep BioSeries™ Melatonin optimized melatonin release throughout the night for a better natural sleep-wake cycle.⁵,⁶*

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · 5-Compared to placebo, based on a rand…
blocks_element.text: 5-Compared to placebo, based on a randomized double-blind, placebo-controlled pharmacokinetic crossover study of Sleep BioSeries™ Melatonin among 10 adults ages 18-31 with reported sleep difficulty

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · 6-Compared to placebo, based on a 2-we…
blocks_element.text: 6-Compared to placebo, based on a 2-week randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover clinical study of Sleep BioSeries™ Melatonin among 12 adults ages 18-31 with reported sleep difficulty

blocks_element.text:
“As a mom of three, I know the importance of diet & nutrition: not just for your own health, but the health of future generations. I also know how hard finding clean, reliable, nutrient support can be.

I founded Ritual with the belief that better health begins with better ingredients. With us, you’ll know where ingredients come from and why it’s there. Some call it obsessiveness, we call it traceability.

It’s why Ritual works with leading scientists, researchers and advisors to create women’s health supplements that meet our highest standards for safety and quality, like Essential Prenatal Multivitamin: the #1 best-selling prenatal backed by its own human clinical trial.”
